about: La Porte County weather radio for laporteweathernow.com (Alerts page). Official NWS information read by an open-source voice (Kokoro-82M, af_heart). Replaced whenever the broadcast changes.

segments.title: Welcome
text: Hello. This is the La Porte Weather Now weather radio for La Porte County, Indiana, with the latest as of 1:32 a.m., Sunday, October 11.

text: Right now at the La Porte airport, it's 61 degrees under clear skies. The wind is from the east-southeast at 8 mph.
